scripts.text: Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower?
scripts.translation: 你是自愿去探索魔神之塔的吗？

scripts.text: It's extremely dangerous so you need to be at least ^4d4dffLevel 130^000000.
scripts.translation: 那里极其危险，所以你的等级至少需要达到^4d4dff130级^000000。

scripts.text: Will you come back when you get stronger?
You know what I mean right?
You want to explore again so soon?
Your body needs to recover from the time traveling.
scripts.translation: 穿越时空后，你的身体还需要时间恢复。

scripts.text: Take a rest day and come back tomorrow.!
I am scheduled to explore today!
I have always been waiting for a member of the expedition!
scripts.translation: 我一直在等探险队的成员！

scripts.text: You can now re-enter the Devil's Tower.
scripts.translation: 你现在可以重新进入魔神之塔。

scripts.text: So time and space seem to have converged there?
scripts.translation: 看来时间和空间在那里交汇了？

scripts.text: I'm amazed that time travel is possible.
scripts.translation: 时间旅行竟然真的可行，令人惊叹。

scripts.text: I look forward to more discoveries!
Oh, you are back so soon...
I look forward to more discoveries!
Let me see... you mean this tower has a passage to connect to the demon world.
scripts.translation: 让我理一理...你是说，那座塔里有一条通往魔界的通道？

scripts.text: I look forward to more discoveries!
Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower? I have been waiting for someone like you!
scripts.translation: 你是自愿去探索魔神之塔的吗？我一直在等待像你这样的人！

scripts.text: Finally, someone to share the mysteries of the tower for me.
scripts.translation: 终于有人来帮我探明塔里的秘密了。

scripts.text: No one has been volunteering up this point so I was getting worried.
scripts.translation: 一直没人报名，我都快急坏了。

scripts.text: Please report anything you find in the tower to me.
scripts.translation: 在塔里有什么发现，都记得向我报告。

scripts.text: The better the info~ the better the zeny I'll pay you!
scripts.translation: 情报越有价值，我付的Zeny就越多！

scripts.text: That Laphine scholar over there will open up the dimensional gap with this time device.
scripts.translation: 那边的拉芬学者会用这台时间装置打开次元裂缝。

scripts.text: It is still unstable so your time for exploring will be limited.
scripts.translation: 它还不稳定，所以你的探索时间有限。

scripts.text: If you are unexpectedly bounced back to here again, you should return quickly.
scripts.translation: 如果意外被弹回这里，就赶快重新进去。

scripts.text: If you do you may or may not be able to re-enter depending on how fast you are.
scripts.translation: 能不能再次进入，就看你动作够不够快了。

scripts.text: But if you run out of time, the access to the tower will disappear.
scripts.translation: 时间一到，通往塔里的通道就会消失。

scripts.text: So do you want to volunteer?
There is nothing I can do I guess.
Okay, gather your party and remember to report to me what you find.
scripts.translation: 好的，召集你的队伍，记得向我报告你的发现。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffExploring time limit is for your safety^000000!
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff探索时间限制是为了你们的安全^000000！

scripts.text: You took an extraordinarily long time.
I can't use any of your info.
There is nothing we can do .
There's always opportunities for other expeditions.
scripts.translation: 总会有其他探险的机会。

scripts.text: First of all, you need to reserve a queue at the gate.
The Laphine Scholar Artie will reserve your queue for you.
scripts.translation: 找拉芬学者阿蒂，他会帮你安排。

scripts.text: Time is limited because the dimensional gap is still unstable.
scripts.translation: 次元裂缝还不稳定，探索时间有限。

scripts.text: Make your exploration short and sweet.
scripts.translation: 进去后要抓紧时间，速去速回。

scripts.text: Rewards will be different depending on your time.
scripts.translation: 奖励会根据你探索所用的时间而有所不同。

scripts.text: I believe that you can manage under these restrictions.
scripts.translation: 我相信你能在这些限制下完成任务。

scripts.text: You seem to be tired of exploring.
scripts.translation: 你似乎对探索感到厌倦了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffIf you cancel now. You will be able to challenge one day after.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff如果你现在取消，一天后就可以再次挑战。^000000

scripts.text: After listening to all this explanation?
let's have fun since we just left bifrost.
scripts.translation: 我们才刚离开毕弗罗斯特，先好好玩玩吧。

scripts.text: you are applying as a volunteer?
scripts.translation: 你是来报名当志愿者的吗？

scripts.text: You'd better gather a party for this expedition.
scripts.translation: 这次探险最好组一支队伍。

scripts.text: Don't take any unncessary risks, okay?
scripts.translation: 不要冒不必要的风险，好吗？

scripts.text: Devil's Tower is not a place to visit alone.
scripts.translation: 恶魔之塔不是一个人能来的地方。

scripts.text: You have already entered by connecting it.
scripts.translation: 已经连接过，也送你进去了。

scripts.text: Connect to the space again? I can not do that.
scripts.translation: 要我再次连接那个空间？这可办不到。

scripts.text: Hrm... It is difficult to connect to unless it is an appointed exploration time.
scripts.translation: 嗯...只有在安排好的探索时段才能连接。

scripts.text: Not to mention dangerous as well.
Are you a volunteer to explore the Devil's Tower?
scripts.translation: 你是来申请探索魔神之塔的志愿者吗？

scripts.text: Do you want me to activate the Dimensional Device?
scripts.translation: 需要我启动次元装置吗？

scripts.text: Decide quickly because you only have a finite amount of time in there.
scripts.translation: 快点决定吧，能待在里面的时间可有限。

scripts.text: Your time to explore is dwindling.
scripts.translation: 你的探索时间所剩无几了。

scripts.text: If you're lucky, you can get through this quickly.
scripts.translation: 顺利的话，很快就能过去。

scripts.text: I look forward to hearing good news.
It is difficult to send to you through the device right now.
scripts.translation: 现在很难通过这台装置把你送过去。

scripts.text: We should stop exploring today and let's go again another day.
scripts.translation: 今天就探索到这里，改天再来吧。

scripts.text: Look, I am sorry but it is not allowed to enter except during the allowed time, Devil's Tower is dangerous.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，魔神之塔太危险，只能在规定时间内进入。

scripts.text: Yes, this is the Dimensional Device.
It is used to travel time.
It will be difficult to enter again if you leave.
scripts.translation: 离开之后就很难再进来了。

scripts.text: Don't worry though, I'm a genius scholar~
scripts.translation: 别担心，我可是天才学者~

scripts.text: It seems like quite a long time has passed since you activated the device. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 从你启动装置到现在，似乎已经过了很久。对吧？

scripts.text: The Dimensional Device needs to be activated first before entering.
scripts.translation: 次元装置需要先启动才能进入。

scripts.text: It doesn't seem to be activated yet.
Please get a permission to activate it by talking to the Magic Scholar Artie.
scripts.translation: 请找魔法学者阿蒂获取启动许可。

scripts.text: Exploring Devil's Tower will be permitted only for expeditions in parties.
scripts.translation: 探索魔神之塔仅允许以队伍形式进行。

scripts.text: I will talk to a representative.
Back up soldiers? So why are you just standing there?
scripts.translation: 你们是援军？那还愣着干什么？

scripts.text: Commander please help me. I can't do it by myself~!
scripts.translation: 指挥官，请帮帮我。我一个人做不到~！

scripts.text: Help Fama take care of the injured soldiers.
scripts.translation: 请协助法玛救治受伤的士兵。

scripts.text: Fama will give you first aid-kits, use it to help the injured people.
scripts.translation: 法玛会提供急救箱，请用它来帮助伤者。

scripts.text: It is priority to treat the injured soldiers by assisting Fama.
scripts.translation: 协助法玛救治受伤的士兵是当务之急。

scripts.text: Please do your best even if the environment is the worst.
scripts.translation: 即使环境恶劣，也请竭尽全力。

scripts.text: Luckily, no one is dead yet.
scripts.translation: 幸运的是，目前还没有人阵亡。

scripts.text: I do not want to see my soldiers die.
scripts.translation: 我不希望看到我的士兵死去。

scripts.text: Please cure the injured with this first aid kit.
scripts.translation: 请用这个急救箱治疗伤者。

scripts.text: It's not difficult. Just follow the instructions.
scripts.translation: 这并不难，只需按照说明操作即可。

scripts.text: We are low on supplies. So I will give them once at a time.
scripts.translation: 物资紧缺，每次只能发一个。

scripts.text: Sorry, please request again if you run out.
Sorry... procurement is not good right now so I can only provide one first-aid kit at a time.
scripts.translation: 抱歉...眼下补给不足，每次只能给你一个急救箱。

scripts.text: Please request again if you run out.
Huh... Okay, we can take a break now.
I need 1 first-aid-kit to treat the injured soldier.
scripts.translation: 我需要1个急救箱来治疗这名受伤的士兵。

scripts.text: This soldier has lost consciousness and groaning.
scripts.translation: 这名士兵已经失去意识，正在呻吟。

scripts.text: Should I use the first-aid kit?
You decide to observe the condition of the injured soldier more.
scripts.translation: 你决定更仔细地观察这名受伤士兵的状况。

scripts.text: You administer the first-aid-kit to the soldier.
scripts.translation: 你为这名士兵使用了急救箱。

scripts.text: whew.. it seems to be okay now.
His conscious seems to be blur still.
scripts.translation: 他的意识似乎还是很模糊。

scripts.text: Leave him to get some rest.
I thought I was going to die.
I can't die here. I have to propose to my beloved when I get home.
scripts.translation: 我不能死在这里。等我回家，一定要向心爱的人求婚。

scripts.text: We will be happy for sure?
I feel much better but I still can't move.
scripts.translation: 我感觉好多了，但还是动不了。

scripts.text: Still I'm lucky to be alive.
scripts.translation: 不过能活着真是太幸运了。

scripts.text: The calamity that happened hundreds of years ago will not happen again right?
scripts.translation: 数百年前发生的灾难不会再次发生，对吧？

scripts.text: Why have the demons showed up again so suddenly?
scripts.translation: 为什么恶魔会突然再次出现？

scripts.text: Are you a member of back-up team?
Good. things are getting worse here.
scripts.translation: 太好了，这里的情况越来越糟。

scripts.text: Glad that you all are here to help.
Who is in charge of the back-up team?
I will guide you to the upper floor.
Do not forget to get rid of any demons that you encounter on the way.
scripts.translation: 路上遇到恶魔时，别忘了消灭它们。

scripts.text: I need more time to prepare.

scripts.translation: 做好应对任何情况的准备。

scripts.text: The Captain says that we need to get rid of all of the demons...
scripts.translation: 队长说，要把所有恶魔清除干净...

scripts.text: A lot of soldiers still survived the attacks.
scripts.translation: 很多士兵在袭击中幸存了下来。

scripts.text: They got rid of all the demons.
scripts.translation: 他们消灭了所有的恶魔。

scripts.text: I was making sure that no one goes upstairs, I was afraid something might happen again.
scripts.translation: 怕再出什么事，我一直守着，不让人上楼。

scripts.text: I wish you would help me.
I have been exploring the passages of this tower for a while now.
scripts.translation: 我已经探索这座塔的通道一段时间了。

scripts.text: You wave your hand in front of her but she doesn't react.
scripts.translation: 你在她面前挥手，但她没有反应。

scripts.text: I am sorry if I'm giving you any attitude but I can't move.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不是故意怠慢你，我现在动不了。

scripts.text: I can use self-recovery but I don't have time for that.
scripts.translation: 我可以自行恢复，可眼下没那个时间。

scripts.text: Will you share your power with me?
I need your help to activate my restoration system.
scripts.translation: 得借助你的力量启动修复系统。

scripts.text: Lucile seems to be a machine.
scripts.translation: 露西尔看起来像台机器。

scripts.text: I can hear mechanical sounds all of a sudden.
Wow! You fixed it faster than I thought.
I have to be fixed occasionally because I don't have a normal body
scripts.translation: 我的身体不太寻常，所以偶尔需要维修。

scripts.text: This body was a gift from the gods.
scripts.translation: 这具身体是神明赐予的礼物。

scripts.text: Do you see the gate in the middle?
scripts.translation: 你看到中间的那扇门了吗？

scripts.text: Hurry up or this world will be in a danger.
scripts.translation: 快一点，否则这个世界就会陷入危险。
因为她大部分是机械构造...

scripts.text: First of all, we have to get rid of these demons!
scripts.translation: 首先，我们必须消灭这些恶魔！

scripts.text: I wonder how the others are doing...
scripts.translation: 不知道其他人怎么样了...

scripts.text: Only Thanatos and Lucile have ever entered to upper floor...
scripts.translation: 只有萨纳托斯和露西尔进入过楼上...

scripts.text: If you want to assist them, you must hurry.
scripts.translation: 如果你想支援他们，必须快点。

scripts.text: I will guide the way for you.
I am sorry but I have been through tough time...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我刚经历了一场苦战...

scripts.text: I am talking to your party leader now so please step back for a while.
scripts.translation: 我正在与你的队长交谈，请暂时退后一下。

scripts.text: Oh. You just have arrived in time.
Do you want to take a look over there?
We need to stop the demon...
scripts.translation: 我们需要阻止那个恶魔...

scripts.text: We need to hold this spot until the trap is set by the Magic Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我们需要守住这里，直到魔剑士设下陷阱。

scripts.text: I guess the power of Demon Morocc to break the shield of seal has collided with Thanatos.
scripts.translation: 大概是梦罗克为了冲破封印而释放的力量，与萨纳托斯的力量发生了碰撞。

scripts.text: It has gone too far somewhere in the south
scripts.translation: 它已经一路扩散到南方某处了。

scripts.text: The collision of those two powers is too much to handle.
scripts.translation: 那两股力量的碰撞实在难以应付。

scripts.text: It could have influenced the south of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 可能已经影响到卢恩-米德加兹南部了。

scripts.text: ...I guess this is what you are able to?
Why are there demons in the castle?!
scripts.translation: 为什么城堡里会有恶魔？！

scripts.text: Why would demons come all of a sudden,
scripts.translation: 恶魔为什么会突然出现，

scripts.text: They are in Morocc castle. My father is a knight.
scripts.translation: 它们在梦罗克城堡。我的父亲是一位骑士。

scripts.text: It seems like something is happening, I hear strange noises downstairs.
scripts.translation: 好像有什么事发生了，我听到楼下有奇怪的声音。

scripts.text: I saw some guys in black entering. What is going on in the castle?
scripts.translation: 我看到几个黑衣人进来了。城堡里到底发生了什么？
爸爸...爸爸一定要平安啊...呜呜...

scripts.text: Please come with me through the passage behind that shelf!
scripts.translation: 请跟我走架子后面的通道！

scripts.text: Behind that shelf is a secret passage to the basement!
scripts.translation: 那个架子后面有一条通往地窖的秘密通道！

scripts.text: Please come with me to make sure my Papa is safe.
scripts.translation: 请跟我来，我要确认爸爸是否安全。

scripts.text: From here.. I do not know well...
scripts.translation: 从这里开始...我也不太清楚...

scripts.text: See there are so many demons. My father will be in a danger!
scripts.translation: 你看，有这么多恶魔。我父亲会有危险的！

scripts.text: You were the rats who were sneaking around here!
scripts.translation: 你们就是那些在这里鬼鬼祟祟的老鼠！

scripts.text: I am talking to your boss.
scripts.translation: 我在跟你们的头儿说话。

scripts.text: You should ^4d4dffTerminate the mercenary contract^000000, if you want to help me on this mission.
scripts.translation: 想帮我完成这次任务，就先^4d4dff解除佣兵契约^000000。

scripts.text: The Lord Knight is no longer human. I have to send him to his eternity for his demonic followings.
scripts.translation: 领主骑士已经不再是人类了。我必须送他和那些恶魔追随者一同归于永寂。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThe ones who are infernally blessed by demons are invincible. We can sever the blessing with Mind Blaster.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff受到恶魔加护的家伙是无敌的，不过可以用心灵净化切断加护。^000000

scripts.text: You will be in charge of activating Mind Blaster.
scripts.translation: 你将负责发动心灵净化。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffLoki, Guillotine Cross of the Assassin Guild, has joined your party.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff刺客公会的十字斩首者洛基加入了你的队伍。

scripts.text: We have to get rid of the demonic Lord Knight by Mind Blasting him with Loki's skill.^000000
scripts.translation: 我们必须用洛基的技能心灵净化来消灭被恶魔附身的骑士领主。^000000

scripts.text: The demon was destroyed before the resurrection ceremony was completed.
scripts.translation: 复活仪式完成前，恶魔就被消灭了。

scripts.text: Things will be fine for awhile.
I have gained unexpected information during my exploration of the Tower.
scripts.translation: 探索魔神之塔时，我意外获得了一些情报。

scripts.text: I will remain apart from my conscience for a bit longer
scripts.translation: 我还得再将良知搁置一段时间。

scripts.text: someday I'll let myself feel again, and today will occupy my thoughts..
scripts.translation: 等哪天能重新正视自己的感受，我会想起今天的事...

scripts.text: What should be done about it?
I am not sure of what my next move is to be..
scripts.translation: 我还不确定接下来该怎么做...

scripts.text: But no matter, you obviously shouldn't be here, now.
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，你显然不该待在这里。

scripts.text: I can send you back where and when you belong.
scripts.translation: 我可以把你送回原本该去的时间和地点。

scripts.text: It is unwise to linger where time is distorted.
scripts.translation: 在时间扭曲的地方逗留是不明智的。

scripts.text: Perhaps, our missions will ally us again in the future..
scripts.translation: 也许，在未来的任务中，我们还会再次并肩作战...
